face_band.caveat: Genuine pairs in this corpus derive from a single source photograph per identity, re-captured to approximate a second photo, so their similarity runs far higher than real selfie-vs-ID pairs would. Consequence: cosine similarity cannot separate a copied ID photo from a genuine pair here (separability AUC 0.5483). The upper bound is therefore set above the genuine distribution rather than fitted, and the reused-photo attack is caught by the image-provenance check in the metadata auditor instead. Re-fit both on production pairs.
